answer: Proof-of-spacetime deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit dedicated disk storage across time. At the dawn of each round, nodes answer challenges within a strict latency delta to prove capacity remains reserved. Each plot acts as an audited pearl of allocated hardware, forcing adversaries to incur verifiable equipment and electricity costs per identity. A key limitation is that entities with vast surplus storage can exploit economies of scale to cheaply generate identities.
